The '''Nebulon-B Support Refit''' was a refit of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] of this class was attacked by several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="Armada" />
